summary: Set `ansible.devSpaces.baseUrl` in `app-config-rhdh.yaml` and restart the RHDH rollout so users can open provisioned Ansible projects in OpenShift Dev Spaces, a separately licensed optional product; otherwise the link goes to the Ansible development tools page.
questions: How do I link the Ansible plug-ins to OpenShift Dev Spaces?
Is Dev Spaces included in the AAP subscription?
Go to OpenShift Dev Spaces dashboard link goes to the wrong page
